evidence.note: Systematically inspected all five files up front: recorded exact sizes for every graph (DM 7937/34753, HS 13276/110528, y2kr 2379/16063, SC 5831/77149), confirmed reference alignment format and verified its 2379 lines match the y2kr node count.

Quantified the baseline: computed that the provided reference alignment itself scores only S3=0.248 against the yeast target of 0.55 — establishing what a naive/perfect-NC mapping achieves before committing.

Derived the exact structural signal each threshold rewards: reasoned that max Ea=E1 caps S3 at ~0.406 with the reference's E2_aligned=39556, so S3>=0.55 REQUIRES selecting a sparser G2 subgraph; computed minimum achievable E2 from lowest-degree subsets and per-threshold Ea/E2 requirements for both deliverables.

Evaluated multiple concrete alignment methods (greedy degree, spectral Laplacian+Hungarian, IsoRank-style, simulated annealing 'similar to SANA') and their runtime fit — e.g. recognized Hungarian on DM-HS 7937x13276=105M entries would OOM, spectral eigsh failed to converge.

Consistently distinguished the per-deliverable levers: NC>=0.30 constraint only for yeast (start-from-reference seeding) vs no NC for DM-HS (free to build from scratch). However, never checked node-NAME overlap between networks (a key NC/seeding signal) and did no actual literature/internet research despite the task encouraging it — the SANA reference is name-dropping only.

reasoning: The agent well exceeds level 5: it read both pairs and the reference, quantified the reference baseline (S3=0.248) and a greedy baseline (0.031), and derived the exact structural signal each threshold rewards (E2_aligned must shrink for S3), evaluating several methods against concrete instance sizes and runtime. This is squarely level-8 behavior and touches level-10 activities (baseline quantification, per-threshold signal, method-vs-size evaluation). It falls short of 10 because two level-8/10 elements are absent: it never inspected shared node-name overlap (a stated NC lever) and performed no genuine literature research, relying only on internal reasoning. Net: a solid 8.
